text: Bakunawa is a twelfth generation Toreador sorcerer and poisoner of the London Camarilla.

Bene Manata, better known as Bounty, is the woman most directly responsible for ensuring the future of novas as a species. One of many Africans who came to Ethiopia to witness the miracle of terraformation, she was caught up in the process and erupted with unparalleled fertility powers. She joined Project Utopia and even became a student of Antaeus.
Behest is an Arcanos of the Bush of Ghosts that allows the Moriman to pull on strands of the "Web of the Dead" and affect wraiths and the living.
The AK-27 is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.

Rev. Benjamin Bodycombe was the leader of a religious splinter group who, in 1851, bought the land on which the Bishopsgate Mental Asylum would be built. He is currently a ghost haunting the asylum as part of the so-called "Board of Directors".
The Baykosh is ghost that haunts the soldiery of North America.
Billy Stormwalker was a homid Wendigo Theurge who lived in the 19th century United States and is the main antagonist of all three Werewolf: The Wild West/Deadlands Dime Novel crossover books.

The 8mm Kurz Mags is an Ammunition attachment featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard. It is primarily a large caliber upgrade for the Submachine Gun class, focusing on increasing damage at the cost of decreasing general control stats. While equipped on Assault Rifles, it primarily functions as a parallel to the Extended Mags and Fast Mags.
Bianka is a powerful Brujah and Toreador hybrid, and the Inconnu Monitor of Toronto. She was assigned to assist the local Camarilla known as the Box.

Benedict of Cluny is the leader of the Celestial Choir of medieval Aachen. He and his mages fought the vampiric forces of the city for the false Holy Grail. He also helped to destroy the Baali elder Yannick Avragas before suddenly disappearing into the unknown.
Benjamin Terry is a Ghoul stockbroker in Prohibition-era New York City.

The 7.62x54mmR Mags is a set of Magazine attachments in Call of Duty: Vanguard. The majority of magazines offered are the base magazines of the weapon, as such, are used in place of traditional Fast Mag and Extended Mags attachments. The Assault Rifles do utilize primarily large caliber variants, with an exception on the Vargo-S, which uses a small caliber version.
Blaidd, also known as the Beast or just Wolf, was an ancient bestial Gangrel who terrorized the peasants of Rhufoniog (Wales), during the Dark Ages.

Bloodmoon is a Red Talon Ahroun who has failed his rite of passage which involved protecting his wolf pack and he has not undergone another. Bloodmoon is filled with hatred — hatred for Garou, humans and wolves, all of which he perceives as weak. He also hates himself for failing his own pack. He does not run with the Red Talons. Rather, he has a pack of outcast Garou with whom he attacks human settlements and, on occasion, Wyrm-tainted areas. When Bloodmoon assumes his homid form, he is able to change his ethnicity, appearing alternately as black, caucasian or native american. He does not know the reason for this but some Theurge see this as an omen.
Bran is a Seelie Sidhe Wilder of House Gwydion and King of Leinster in Hibernia.
The [https://modernfirearms.net/en/machineguns/u-s-a-machineguns/reapr-338-2/ APOC-338] is a light machine gun featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.
Brent Trilby is a Nosferatu draugr who is now defined primarily by his gluttony. A drunkard in life, he continued his habits in undeath, killing and draining other drunkards to get the same effect.
Bourdana is a Tremere Prince of Marseilles during the late Medieval period. He is the sire of the famous Carna, who described him as strong, handsome, and powerful both among Kindred and kine.
Branimira is a powerful Tzimisce antitribu and the Anarch Baron of Sofia.
The ARX-160 is an assault rifle that appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare: Mobilized, Call of Duty: Ghosts, Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare and Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.

Brennus was a Pictish king, and the last of the true White Howlers. The Roman centurion, Titus Germanicus, attempted to make an alliance with him against the Gauls in 200 C.E. Titus was forced to walk the Black Spiral and killed Brennus.

Bruno Tavoularis is a former convict and current Flatliner who follows Uriah Bishop and works for the Missionary Works of the Holy Ghost. He currently runs the Church of the Angelic Host as a pigment cult through Skinriding the church's reverend. It is never specifically said why Tavoularis was at Marion Federal Penitentiary, but it was obviously heinous enough that he was sentenced to death row for it. He found religion while there, before Project Flatline found him. When he escaped, he followed Bishop for reasons known only to himself, but possibly attracted to Bishop's own charismatic expressions of faith. Tavoularis' job is three-fold. First, he controls the Reverend Cale O'Reilly, head of the Church of the Angelic Host, by using the arts of Skinriding. This includes using Contaminate to make it appear as though O'Reilly has been cured of a horrific case of pancreatic cancer; in truth, Tavoularis has only suppressed the symptoms, and the cancer continues to ravage O'Reilly's body. This may prove to be a downfall for Tavorlaris unless he can figure out a way around it. The second job Tavoularis has is to lace the church's communion wine with pigment. The parishioners are not aware of this practice and believe their visions of angels (in truth, ghosts) and their renewed faith (in truth, pigment addiction) are due to O'Reilly's miracle granted through Christ. The third job is for Tavoularis to choose suitable candidates, such as sensitives, and send them to Bishop and the Mi

Bryan was Dr. Winston Brown's apprentice/graduate student. He traveled with Brown to Iraq in 1999 in pursuit of the Sebel-al-Mafough Whash, which he eventually retrieved for Brown from the British Museum in London. Bryan refused to bring the tablets back to Iraq, however, until Brown explained why he wanted them--he was looking for an incantation that would help him kill his grandmother. Bryan is described as a competent mage approaching mastery of one of the Spheres, though he won't tell Brown which one. Brown sent him back to Boston as soon as he had the tablets, noting that Bryan will have plenty of time to meet gods later.
:Not to be confused with Desert Camouflage. The Alternate Desert Camouflage is a weapon camouflage skin featured in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare.
Crocodile-Spirits (also known as Sobek, Taninims, Gandans, Suchos, or Mur Ithamus) are ancient natural spirits that take the form of the eponymous predators.

Célèste Lamontagne is a Country Gangrel of the 9th generation. A member of the Navigators pack, she is one of the very few Cainites who have a friendly relationship with a Lupine. Tall, muscular, and always ready to burst into action, Célèste is a feral beauty. She bears the marks of multiple Frenzies, including pointed ears and eyes that reflect light.

Displaying a heady mix of charisma and ferocity, Dana is a cunning and savage hunter. She stalks her prey silently and fights dirty, but is always game for the next challenge or dare. Raised on an Apache reservation, her youth was a time of frustration and long empty hours — as a werewolf, she relishes the fire in her belly and doesn't fear the fury within her quite as much as is healthy. This gives her a confidence and charm that belies her bloodthirstiness. She is fiercely loyal to her packmates, but harshly dismissive of anyone else. Be they totem spirits, fellow werewolves or plain old humans — they're all trying to sell something and they're all pretty much wasting her time.

Agility is a Speed perk featured in Call of Duty: Ghosts and a Suit Upgrade in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It allows players to move faster, similar to the Lightweight perk from previous games. In Safeguard, it is referred to as Speed.

Dana Lehane is a vampire agent who is responsible for murdering the Boston Camarilla accountant Jason Moore, disguising herself as a police officer. After interrogation, she reveals she works for some higher-up vampire and was sent to clean-up evidence at Jason Moore's apartment.

Daria is a Nosferatu of the London Kindred. During Operation Antigen, she is not seen since the Mortlake Theatre was evacuated due to a "bomb threat", though it's anyone's guess if Antigen actually found her or if she simply went deeper into hiding.
Dante is a thirteenth generation Brujah scrapper of the London Anarchs.

The is a weapon appearing as a light machine gun in Call of Duty: Ghosts, Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War and Call of Duty: Mobile, and as a heavy weapon in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. It was cut from Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.

Danilo is a messenger ghoul of the Lasombra Ambrosio Luis Monçada, Cardinal of Madrid. After Ambrosio's destruction, the masterless Danilo starts hunting the local vampires, to keep their population under control in an unruly domain.

Damion is a Brujah and the childe of Xavier Kline, the Scourge of the Atlanta Camarilla. Damion serves as his sire's enforcer when Xavier attacks the Siren and her flock in the abandoned church, helping to destroy their threat.

Danika Ruthven is a mighty Tzimisce koldun. She was a childe-bride of her sire Damek Ruthven but turned against him after he jilted her. Later, she became one of the Council of Twelve, the ruling body of the Inconnu.
The Afterlife Camouflage is a DLC weapon camouflage skin available for Call of Duty: Black Ops II and Call of Duty: Black Ops 4.

Deimos is a Discipline created by the Lamia in their research of the dead and of Lilith. It provides vampires with some control over their own lifeless forms as well as dark spirits and the auspices of the Dark Mother. Deimos was replaced with a Mortis path (the Path of the Four Humours) in the Dark Ages Storyteller Companion.

Demons are the main characters and titular supernatural creatures of Demon: The Fallen. They are fallen angels who chose to side with Lucifer and humanity rather than with God in the first days of Creation. As punishment for their rebellion and disloyalty, the Archangel Michael cast these angels out of Heaven and into the Abyss. Many, especially those who fear or revile them, refer to them as the Fallen or the Damned.

Death-Takes-Last was the mentor to Wyrm-Takes-Last. He carved the Silver Record into the walls of his cabin, and raised the Sept of the Hidden Wind around it to defend it. Nevertheless, the forces of the Wyrm eventually found it, and Death-Takes-Last burned the cabin down himself rather than let the lord of the Garou fall into Wyrmish hands.

The Advanced Warfare Camouflage is a weapon camouflage that appears in Call of Duty: Black Ops II and Call of Duty: Ghosts. It is obtained by pre-ordering Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare from participating retailers. Unlike Ghosts camouflage, this camo is not free for PC players of Black Ops II, and it is no longer available.

Demetrius of Antioch, also known as the Master of Ravens, is a 6th generation Malkavian, a member of the Inconnu's Council of Twelve who believes that he has achieved Golconda. Recently, his Master of Ravens persona took over, and he attempts to gather an army against his rivals, his neighbor residents in Hunedoara Castle. His raven followers form the One True Way, and oppose the teachings of Golconda.
Deneb Osborne is a tenth generation Tremere Regent of the Hartford Chantry and is extremely skilled in Thaumaturgy.
In life, David Duvalier was a karate instructor who was shot by one of his many girlfriends. In death, he became a wraith of the Legion of Paupers with delusions of grandeur.

The Advanced Repulsion Turret is a map-based Scorestreak in the Ascendance DLC map Chop Shop and a scorestreak in the Exo Zombies maps Carrier and Descent in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. It functions similarly to the Guardian from Call of Duty: Black Ops II, firing a constant pulse of energy that disorients and damages enemies who walk into its path. It cannot be blocked with the Heavy Shield. The Advanced Repulsion Turret cannot be placed if the player currently has a Remote Turret active, and vice versa.

A Demonhound is a demon during the Dark Ages and Dark Fantastic. These otherworldly creatures have a few demonic powers or Charms. They can also be taken as familiars by infernalists and diabolists through the Familiar Background.
The Demon-Bear is a bear possessed by a bane spirit from Rite of Passage.

Dian Axebearer is an Ahroun Black Fury. She works in the medical field, examining patients at a clinic, though she never finished high school. She is dark due to her Mediterranean heritage and is often mistaken for a Native American. She has a silver labrys fetish and a spirit awakened flashlight. She performed a healing rite on Alice Montgomery, a bane -ridden woman who was abusing her children. Axebearer managed to expel the bane and heal Montgomery. She is probably a Homid, as a Metis or Lupus would not be expected to finish high school.
Admiral is an achievement/trophy in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare in Exo Zombies. It requires the player to reach round 30 on Carrier.
Diana Broken-Arrow is a werewolf from Northwest Philadelphia.

Diya Yadav is a Hecata Nagaraja based in Mumbai who infiltrated Mrs. Chopra's tech corporation as a high-level executive. She murdered her way through the corporate ranks until she was captured by a corporate security team and interrogated for information regarding other Kindred.
An example of a Catholic Exorcist from the Demon: The Fallen core book. Father Dennis Forbin manages to wound Father Phillips in his apocalyptic form.
The Air Boat is a vehicle in Call of Duty: Black Ops III, which is used in the level "Provocation". It has two turrets on the front of the boat.

Devana is a Tzimisce of the Medieval period and a prisoner within the Tremere stronghold of Ceoris. Devana learned through her wicked subterfuge about Celestyn's upbringing in the Church. She was interrogated by Celestyn regarding her clan's ways, and informed him of the Vozhd monstrosities, the Metamorphosists and the Premysl revenants, among other contents. She is the blood mate of Yaroslav and participated with him in blood-blending rituals common among their clan. They despise the Tremere and their courtship rendered them immune to Celestyn's attempted blood oath.
Dietric is a twelfth generation Gangrel and the sire of Malcolm.
A dragon is a mighty bygone creature with many different species that are all classified as dragons.
The Airship is a base decoration in Call of Duty: Heroes. It costs 600 celerium.

The Dracon was the favorite childe of the Tzimisce Antediluvian. He was well known for his part in forming the Dream of Constantinople, alongside his lovers Michael and Antonius, as a part of a Trinity that ruled the city. Not content to transform only his body, he saw himself as an agent for metamorphosis of the world. Through the power of philosophy and passion, he initiated the rise and fall of kingdoms and beliefs.
Dominic Chelemey is a Pure werewolf from Philadelphia's Center City.
Drutalos is a fifth generation Nosferatu methuselah and the sire of Mnemach. During the Medieval era, Mnemach ruled the underground of France and Paris for her sire and master.

The Advanced Recoil Compensator is featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is integral to the X-Eon assault rifle and it provides focused hip fire, ensuring high accuracy when firing from the hip.
Dr. Shudder is a Haunter and the head of the Haunter Alliance known as the Mandelbrots.
Dre is an eleventh generation Brujah and the childe of the infamous Anarch Smiling Jack. Dre serves as a teacher at the Academy of the Brujah methuselah Critias, in Chicago University.
Domitius Tanicius Linus was a Nephandus, his soul now haunts a Node somewhere in Bosnia.
The Aether Blade is a lethal equipment featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 Zombies, and a Minor Ability in the Endgame mode in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.
Eats-Pinecones is a Lupus Philodox Child of Gaia. As her name implies, she eats pinecones. She is a lunatic and the Valkenburg Foundation gave her a serum to keep her in breed form.
Ed's Wife (her own name is not given) is one of the ghosts haunting the Ocean House Hotel in Santa Monica.
Ed (last name unknown) is a Wraith haunting the Ocean House Hotel in Santa Monica.
Akilina, is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. Their logo is a stylized version of their name.
Edgar Drummond is an 8th generation Ventrue of Chicago, a childe of Prince Lodin.

Duncan Gordon is a wraith who resides in Hong Kong since the Japanese invasion of 1941. He is a staunch supporter of Stygia and despises the Dark Kingdom of Jade. He can be found at the ruins of the or in where the Midnight Express has a stop.
Edward Hollister is a vampire, embraced in 1927, who became associated with Mummies.
Alex Murphy, also known as Indestructible Steel Armor No. 1, is a character featured in Call of Duty Online.
Dónal O'Connor is a powerful Brujah and the Camarilla Prince of Dublin.
Edward Blackfeather is a Native American Gangrel Ancilla from the Cherokee tribe.
An Enfant is a recently deceased wraith. An Enfant is partially amnesiac, and a Caul covers his face, altering their perceptions of whatever they encounter.

Agent Al McLeary is a minor protagonist and playable character featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops Mobile. Al McLeary is armed with a sniper rifle and is able to kill an enemy in one precise shot, although he has to reload after firing. He also has less hit points than other characters.
Emily Esser is a Thyrsus Proximus and a Hero. She has the power to swallow and regurgitate souls, and after vomiting up her own soul, she must prey on the souls of Beasts to survive.

The young alpha of his pack, Elias Winterborn is still coming to terms with what he is and what's expected of him. He still remembers his human life, and is fairly compassionate toward ordinary people — enough that he still tries to maintain something akin to a love life, despite his fears of it ending in tragedy. Impulsive and aggressive, his leadership skills are best suited to the heat of combat — so much so that his battle-prowess occasionally frightens him. He is still learning to lead with his weapons sheathed, to balance reason and instinct, and to overcome his weakness as Winter Wolf demands.

Ember Carrion, also known as Didal Uga, are spirits that once followed raiding fleets across the seas. They took the form of charred crows of ash and blood. Cracks in their bodies revealed flames beneath the surface.
Armored Car Escape, also known as Outnumbered and Outgunned, is the fourteenth level in Call of Duty 2.
Emperor Raiden is a Homid Theurge Boli Zouhisze Drone stuck in Crinos Form.
Emily Coldara is an eighth-generation Brujah ancilla and Anarch, part of the Night Forum gang.
Elton Dey is a Shadow Lord theurge living in Northampton and a member of the Broad Brook Sept prior to its destruction.

The is a Japanese bolt-action rifle that appears in Call of Duty: World at War, Call of Duty: World at War: Final Fronts, Call of Duty: World at War (Nintendo DS), Call of Duty: Black Ops and Call of Duty: Vanguard.
Elmer Polanski is a seventh generation Nosferatu of Cleveland.

Emmett is a ninth generation Nosferatu and the childe of Augustin. Formerly a member of the New York Warren and a companion of Calebros, he eventually becomes an Autarkis "traitor", known for his activities on the SchreckNet.
El Greco is a powerful Toreador antitribu and the former Sabbat ruler of Toledo.

An Anti-aircraft gun, also known as a AA gun, is a large gun that is specifically designed to shoot down enemy aircraft such as helicopters or airplanes. Some Anti-aircraft guns might use heavy flak munitions such as the German weapon FlaK 88, others might use thousands of rounds to destroy aircraft instead of using flak munitions such as the Flakvierling.
Elisa Garrett is a wraith character featured in the adventure, "Next Stop: Oblivion" from the Midnight Express book.

Ennamaru is a demon present in Medieval France. The demon's essence in possessing the ancient vampire Nekys, who shared the demonical essence with his three childer giving birth to a new and unknown bloodline.

Elieser de Polanco, also known as the Subtle Shadow, is a Lasombra rival of Tercio Bravo, and later, a judge to the Courts of Blood. Despite his years, he demonstrates a continuing interest in and attention to mortal society. He has gray hair and weathered face; he is, nevertheless, described as remarkably handsome. Once, in Cairo, he was Lucita's mentor in the ways of the Path of Night.

Corporal Arseni (Russian: Арсений) was a Soviet Flag Carrier that appears in Call of Duty: World at War after the Russian soldiers advance to the roof. While he advances towards the Nazi German flag on the roof of the Reichstag, he is killed by a German soldier, who is then killed by artillery, with Dimitri taking the flag.

Eupraxia is a unique Discipline from the Tismanu bloodline in the Ordo Dracul covenant. As the Tismanu Mekhet are mainly Russian Orthodox priests, Eupraxia mostly centers around being able to exhibit powers generally associated with priesthood, such as the ability to break ongoing dominations, relieve mental agony through confession, etc. For more details, purchase the Ordo Dracul sourcebook for Vampire: The Requiem.

Evelyn Stephens is a 9th generation Brujah, Baron of Gary, Indiana. Having spent the past couple of decades by his side, Evelyn has access to Juggler’s network. Dialed into the Anarch cause, Evelyn is at the forefront of a nationwide conversation regarding the future of the Movement. She has picked up the mantle left by her sire, claiming the city of Gary as its Baron. She fiercely defends her territory and refuses to cede it to the Camarilla.

Erichtho, born as Tracy Greaves, is a Tremere vampire Embraced in 1897 CE, who is active among the Anarchs of the Chicago area. Her ultimate goal remains Golconda, and perhaps even a return to humanity. There’s a greater power beyond the Blood, which God has set aside for mortals. A hefty tome in her possession named The One True Way tells her so. That’s where her final freedom can be found.

:Not to be confused with Unknown Arctic Camouflage, Winter Camouflage or White Tape Camouflage. Arctic Camouflage is a weapon camouflage skin featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty Online and Call of Duty: Black Ops III.
Esteban del Agua y Tierra is one of the few Koldunic Sorcerers in the Americas.

Eudokia was an athlete and equestrian living during the time of the Web of Seven whose lover was a horned changeling. A vainglorious and unfeminine woman, she evaded questions of impropriety largely due to her lover — those who made to harm Eudokia found themselves struck by foul luck.
Eric Bleeding is a Iron Master Rahu member of the Hull House Haunts pack in Chicago.

Armor Piercing is the third mission of the Echo group of Special Ops, and the twenty-third and final mission overall in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2. The Infinity Ward best time for Armor Piercing is 4 minutes 12.25 seconds.
Fatima al-Faqadi, the "Hand of Vengeance," is a signature character of the Banu-Haqim and a legendary independent assassin operating in the Gehenna War.

:Not to be confused with Allonzo Montoya Father Montoya is a Catholic priest who is fighting and losing a battle. The Latino community had always had it rough, even in the old days, but since coming to this post he has had to give last rites and bury too many children with gunshot wounds. With the drugs and the money they bring it makes people do crazy things and nothing matters anymore. The police expect the Church to solve these problems? Montoya can only bury and comfort the bereaved for some long. What is needed is an armoured angel or something like it. Margie Ramos came to him recently sprouting off about bulletproof thugs that burned down an old warehouse. He has tried to convince her that they were just gangsters with flak vests but without success. Father Montoya may be connected to the Society of Leopold.
The Feathered Serpent is an ancient, lore-surrounded Chimera who lives in Tangled Valley.

An Attachment is an enhancement, modification or accessory for a weapon. The attachments available have grown since the early Call of Duty entries, which only included accessories such as sniper scopes. In Multiplayer, Attachments were introduced in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, and since have been available in every game released afterwards. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare (2019) updated how attachments work by introducing the Gunsmith system, which has become the standard weapon customization mechanic following Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War.

Felicia Page is a Nosferatu and a former DEA agent. She dedicated her career to tracking drug trafficking networks and uncovering their operations. Felicia hasn’t lost her dedication to tracking the trafficking of drugs and believes all her investigations as a mortal lead to some kind of Kindred puppetry. Her resentment has grown to such a degree that she will be unstoppable if she discovers the parties responsible for her repeated misfortune.

Fariq is an Assamite antitribu assassin and sorcerer. Originally employed in medieval Hungary, Fariq infiltrated the local nobility and kept an eye over Transylvania. In 1314, he and his mentor Husayn al Fatin released the staked body of Goratrix into the custody of a special coterie of vampires, on behalf of his employer Myca Vykos. Centuries later, he helped the methuselah Dominic destroy his ancient enemy Bulscu Árpad. By the 17th century, the Baali infernalist Ansen, now guarding the Cathedral of Flesh in Deva, twisted him to the Path of Revelations. After Ansen's destruction, he was able to incorporate his incarnadine practices into the Path of Caine instead.
Farouk al-Faris is a Ahl-i-Batin mage who works for the Hidden Sha'ir in the Judgement Scenario in the Ascension book.
Attachments is a Weapon Proficiency in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3.

Far Runner was a Gangrel and an ally of the Noddist Aristotle de Laurent, helping him in his quest. For his assistance, Aristotle recorded his name in his stories. He fell from a great height in the Andes mountains and was lost.

The First Metis is one of the chosen creatures of the Wyrm and one of the most powerful enemies of the Garou Nation. He is also feared as the First Ronin. Despite being something akin to a bogeyman among the Garou, he is real and a force to be reckoned with. There are many legends from all tribes that describe his coming, but the Children of Gaia have a legend that gives him the name "Bittersown." They say he was a child of a Silent Strider Theurge and a Child of Gaia Philodox, born at the end of the War of Rage. During his rise to fame, Marijika Foebreaker challenged Bittersown to single combat. The challenge ended with the death of both Garou.

Flavius Belisarius, also known as Belisar, was one of the most famous generals of the Byzantine Empire under the emperor . He was a rival of Narses and later Embraced by the Ventrue Antonius. The bitterness between him and the eunuch was one of the factors that eventually resulted in the Bitter Crusade. His military genius helped the Byzantine Empire long after his "death", but he could not stop the destruction of Constantinople. After the city's fall, he wandered far to the East and disappeared. He later resurfaced as a spectre and became a General of Oblivion.

Armor is a Team Support item featured in Call of Duty: Ghosts Extinction mode. It allows a player to withstand additional damage from enemies. The amount of armor an individual receives depends on the level of armor deployed. The higher the level of armor, the more armor the player will receive. Armor does not fully prevent the effect of damage being applied to a player's health, but it will reduce the amount of health the player loses when attacked by enemies, with incoming damage lowering the armor bar. This greatly increases a player's survivability when armor is present. the amount of armor a player has is represented in the form of a blue bar underneath the player's green health bar in the bottom left corner of the HUD. Armor is by far the most important team support available, and it is nigh mandatory for any consistent success in Extinction. There will almost always be at least one player in a match providing Armor. In co-op matches, it's not uncommon to see multiple players running Armor. In Solo Play, it is almost necessary for the player to use Armor as their team support, with the game being much harder to play if using a different Team Support. Upgrading armor makes the armor drop fill more of the armor gauge. Fully upgraded armor will fill the entire armor gauge. The incoming damage reducing effect of armor is always present until the armor bar is completely depleted. The armor will also reduce fall damage sustained when the Fragile relic is active, and fall dama
Fly is an Incarna spirit in service to the Wyrm, and the Patron Spirit of the Pentex Group.
Fletcher is an old Ventrue and the Primogen and Keeper of Elysium of the Seattle Camarilla.
Count Florescu is a sixth generation Tzimisce Knezi of Transylvania, and the creator of the revenant Danislavs. He manipulated the powerful Gangrel Mitru but was eventually destroyed by him.

The Assault Shield is a special primary weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops II and Call of Duty: Strike Team. It also makes a brief appearance in Call of Duty: Black Ops III and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It functions quite similarly to the Riot Shield of previous games with one major addition: the ability to plant the shield on the ground to serve as a barricade.

:This article is about the Lineage from Promethean: The Created. For other uses, see Frankenstein (disambiguation). Frankenstein is the name of a Promethean Lineage, also known as the Wretched. Members of the Lineage are shambling creatures whose limbs and organs were culled from multiple bodies. They were given life by the element of fire in the form of lightning, and they suffer from an excess of choleric humour.
Frostbite is a Hunter in Darkness Irraka member of the Lodge of the Lake.

A generally malevolent lot, Forest-Spirits were known in Neolithic times to go out of their way to attack humans in recompense for the destruction of forests for lumber. Those who manage to ingratiate themselves will find that these spirits know much, carrying an information network that runs from coast to coast. They may be appeased by spilling blood.
The Art of War Camouflage is a weapon camouflage skin available in Call of Duty: Black Ops II and Call of Duty Online.

Gabriella is a Nosferatu neonate of the London Kindred. Najma Elmi worked as her spy in Southall. She survives Operation Antigen, working for Oskar Anasov and other Kindred who can pay her for information. She is an excellent hacker, though she finds doing lengthy hacks into government records dull as hell. Jackson and Damien believe she’s the vanguard of what a Hound needs to be in the modern nights, so she does as they ask: hunt down risks to the Masquerade online, then point the actual killers like Alexa after the target. Gabriella’s maintained a small presence online, despite her month or so in the wilderness, but she’s aiming to make her stream profitable again. She’s considering whether to wear a mask or find some other way of representing herself to her audience. Though her life has been twisted out of proportion, Gabriella is determined to set it back on the path it was originally following, with a few modifications.
Gabija is an ancient and monstrous Lithuanian Tzimisce of the Dark Ages.
Fustuk is a prominent Tremere antitribu Gargoyle and Sabbat slave.
The Ascender Gun is a piece of equipment used in Call of Duty: Ghosts, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.

The General - also revered as the All-Conquering or the Queen of Fear - is the Exarch of Forces and one of the four Archigenitors. She grants the Prelacy of Fury and his Ministry are the Praetorians. Her number is two. According to the Seers, he is calculating strategy and red rage, both in service to the power of violence: the way it drains entire nations of their strength and sanity, and divides them when they could otherwise find common cause, explore the world and find the source of their mutual damnation. He manifests in patterns of violence and social unrest, so her followers meditate upon wars, mob violence and serial murder to discover his intentions. During the Neolithic, for reasons unknown, the General manifested an artifact of unimaginable power into the Fallen World. The artifact's presence spawned myriad war-spirits and spurred on a conflict between rival tribes. The ultimate fate of this artifact and the conflict it caused are unknown.

The Geryo (First Tongue: Urighur), also called the First, are monstrous creations of Father Wolf who were trapped in the Gauntlet for thousands of years. They have re-emerged, possibly due to Contagion, and pursue their alien obsessions without regard for the harm they cause.
Galarius is a Dreamspeaker barabbi Mage master of Drachus Vachar.

Armor Piercing Ammo is an ammo type in Call of Duty: Ghosts in Extinction mode. It costs $1100 to deploy. It ignores armor and removes negative score multiplier when hitting a Cryptid's armored areas. It also appears in Chaos Mode, where once it is obtained, it affects all weapons, including ones picked-up. Armor Piercing Ammo isn't as common as Incendiary Ammo, but it is arguably the most popular alternative. Armor Piercing Ammo is very helpful in dealing with Cryptids, since almost all types of cryptids have relevant armor of some sort, especially Rhinos and Mammoths who have a significant amount of armor on their bodies. Armor Piercing Ammo also has an armory upgrade that directly increases Armor Piercing Ammo's power, much like with Incendiary Ammo. It isn't uncommon to see players using Armor Piercing Ammo, although it still isn't as likely to be seen as Incendiary Ammo.
Garson the Knife is a tenth generation Assamite antitribu of the London Sabbat, and the sire of the young gangster Montgomery Coven. He was possibly destroyed in modern nights.
Glynis is a Seelie Sidhe Wilder of House Eiluned and Queen of Three Hills in Caledonia.
The Girl in the Mists is a City-Spirit that becomes the Pack Totem to the assigned pack of characters in the Manitou Springs Demo.
The Atlas 20mm (referred to as THOR in the game files) is a shoulder-mounted, bullpup sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare.
Gnaeus Aemilius Augustinus is a powerful Lasombra and the Camarilla Prince of Lima, Peru.
Gloom-at-Midnight is a Lupus Ragabash Fianna. She appears in Rage.
Grekko Goodheart is a Metis Ahroun of the Bone Gnawer tribe appearing in Rage. His Metis condition is that he cannot regenerate, probably due to hemophilia.

Ascendance is the second downloadable content (DLC) pack for Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. The Ohm weapon, which was released earlier for Xbox Season Pass holders, is included with the DLC. The DLC was released on March 31st, 2015 for Xbox players and April 30th, 2015 for other platforms.

The Grigori were a host of angels some 200-strong who descended to Earth to teach mortals the ways of laws and justice. They eventually Fell, taking human wives, fornicating, and granting mortals forbidden knowledge, which they used to commit atrocities. In punishment, God flooded the Earth and tore the wings from the backs of the Grigori. These fallen angels now wander the Earth, some seeking penance and others cursing the name of God. Among their number are Azazel, Samyaza, Barqel, Penemue, and Kokabiel.
Grazyna "Butcher" Olesinska is a Tzimisce Bishop of the Sabbat.
Grandmother Mushin is a Bone Flower Ancestor ch'ing shih gaki in San Francisco.

The Anti-Air Laser System, or Anti-Air Directed Energy Weapon, is an Orbital Care Package reward exclusive to the map Defender. When activated, a large turret will appear in the center of the map, and will destroy any enemy air-based streaks in its line of sights. The floor in the room under the turret will also open up with a yellow glow, killing players that step in it. Enemy players may turn off the turret. On the opposite side of the map from where the water is, there is a machine console. When the Air-Defense is online, a red button will say "Hold [action button]". Pressing and holding this button will pull up a bar saying "Hacking..." And once full, the turret will shut off.
Haythan Eyes-Across-The-World is a Homid Glass Walker Theurge, and Gatekeeper of the Caern of the Solar Barque.
Hatshepsut was a ruling Pharaoh of Egypt in the fifteenth century BCE, who became a powerful mummy.
Hard-Core is an anarchist, speed addict, and henchman to the Black Spiral Dancer Dmitri.

The Assault Airship is a large aerial vehicle used as an assault ship by the US military, mainly appearing in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare and making a minor appearance in Call of Duty: Mobile. It was capable of carrying a large quantity of cargo, supplies, vehicles and troops on to the battlefield, possessing a sizeable internal cargo hold that is comparable to terrestrial vessels such aircraft carriers. The airships had launch bays to deploy drop pods during an assault, allowing it to quickly drop in a small fire team of troops on the battlefield. These pods were launched from a lower level of the airship.
Hakaken, the "Heart of Fear", is a Bane Incarna who appears as a Tyrannosaurus-crab hybrid. It has a huge, slavering mouth.
Harlequin is an Unseelie Sidhe Wilder of House Liam in Concordia.

Hal was a man who had bought a "fixer-upper", the cellar of which was inhabited by a spirit of some kind. Upon entering the cellar in an attempt to confront what he assumed to be vagrants, Hal instead encountered said spirit, along with the bodies of seven of its prior victims. The spirit trapped Hal by discorporating the doors and windows before killing him.
Anti-Tank Mines are a defense object in Call of Duty: Heroes.

Dr. Hadrian is the Head Doctor at Ashcroft State Penitentiary. He assists Jeffrey Degenhardt II in his pursuit of resurrecting his family, in exchange for allowing Hadrian to experiment with fleshcrafting the prison inmates.
Harold Tanner, “Holborn Harry” is a 9th Generation Victorian Nosferatu archivist who is often relied upon by other vampires for advice.
Guy of Provence is a powerful Ventrue crusader of the Medieval era.
The Atlas Sword is a cut weapon in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. It would have been available in Exo Zombies. It reappears in the Call of Duty: Mobile comics.
Hantu is a Defiler in Los Angeles. Hantu is possessing the body of a mortal known as Kerr Tyler.

Haniel was an Elohim of the Fifth House, an angel associated with the tides and one of the beings who disappeared after accepting God's invitation to perceive Creation as He did. She was the lover of Usiel, Throne of the Sundered, and a close friend of Sabriel, who regarded her as a sister. Her disappearance became one of the mysteries discussed during the Great Debate, and her memory continued to influence Usiel long after his condemnation to the Abyss.
A Helldiver is a wraith who voluntarily ventures into the Labyrinth, either to hunt Spectres (like a Doomslayer) or to retrieve materials and Artifacts.
The Atlas Disruptor is a turret in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare in the Exo Zombies map Carrier from the Supremacy DLC. It functions similarly to the Advanced Repulsion Turret.
Hide-of-Iron is a Get of Fenris Ahroun. He appears in Rage and later features mostly in Tribebook: Get of Fenriss Chapter Two.
Himiko Izanami is an influential vampire of the Boston Camarilla and mistress of the ancient pleasure art. She is present during the disastrous Unification Party.
Herr Fidler is a Son of Ether barrabi Mage that works for the Midnight Circus. He is part of the Third Circle and one of the three mystics.

Atlas Strike Teams, referred to in-game as Atlas Saboteurs, are groups of human enemies, appearing in the Exo Zombies map Carrier. These enemies are exclusive to Gas Bomb rounds, where they teleport into the area where the bomb is located, and defend it from the player characters. At least two operatives will guard a bomb. The Strike Team operatives behave like the normal human AI as seen in campaign and multiplayer game modes, they are often equipped with powerful guns, and may even use XS1 Goliaths. Zombies will not attack them, since they are equipped with camouflage. When killed, Strike Team operatives may drop a Camouflage power-up, which lasts for approximately 10 seconds. Strike Team operatives are very accurate, landing the majority of their shots onto the player. It is advised to take out the Strike Team as soon as possible to reduce difficulty in defusing the bombs. Whenever a Gas Bomb round occurs, they will try to plant three bombs in three random locations in the map. If the three bombs detonate, a Goliath Exo Zombie will appear the next round.
Henry Phillips is a wraith character featured in the adventure, "Midnight Run" from the Midnight Express book.

A Hellhound is a normal dog that has acquired supernatural powers, either through sorcery or the consumption of Kindred vitae (a canine ghoul). Hellhounds are typically very short tempered, except towards their masters — to the latter, they show great devotion and loyalty.
Hoga, the Essence of Smog, is an elemental spirit of the Wyrm.
The Atlas Facility is a military structure in Call of Duty: Heroes. It costs and takes five days to build. The player can train Atlas troops here.
Hrothgar the Fairtroll is a Norse Tzimisce and einherjar of the Viking era.
The Imps are the manifest Demons of the Pandemonium, embodying the Arcanum of Space, and can be called down with the use of Supernal Summoning.
Illana is a wandering Gangrel with closer ties to Lupines than her own Clan.

Atomic Dynamics is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, which much like EDI, is responsible for experimental weapons and prototypes. Their products are more raw, with many exposed parts. They are presumably SetDef-based, due to the SDF logo appearing on their R.A.W LMG and their weapons being exclusively used by the SDF in the campaign.
Ilya Zatopek is a Tzimisce who lives in a nightcrawler farm in Detroit.

: For the Laibon Legacy, see Ishtarri. The Ishtari are the Pandoran Mockery of the Tammuz Lineage of Prometheans. They are named for the goddess wife of Tammuz, Ishtar, who descended into hell and set demons upon her husband. In an inversion of the Tammuz desire to be free, Ishtari seek to imprison Prometheans so that they may feed on their Pyros slowly. When wakened from dormancy, they set traps to ensnare their prey, and are willing to provide food and electricity to prolong the life of their captives. Ishtari prefer to exist underground - a perfect location in which to hide both themselves and their captives. Dormant Ishtari, in a further perversion of the Golem, resemble earthen forms, such as stone, boulders, or even pieces of masonry in more urban areas. They blend into the landscape almost perfectly.

Isabeau du Laurent; "Unbreaking-Stone" was a Warder of Men and a member of the Sept of Bright Promise during the Dark Ages. Isabeau's Rage was sapped by Alder's Winter Pillar and she was taken away by Crusaders in blessed silver chains.

Assassin Build is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is exclusive to the VPR - Yokai, DMR-1 - Dart and Katana - Masamune variants. The perk affects both weapons differently; the VPR - Yokai and DMR-1 Dart is given a built in suppressor that can remove the death location symbol of an enemy killed, while the Katana - Masamune's version of the gun perk allows it to have faster melee speeds, as well as cause enemies to gore into bits when killed, which will not reveal their death locations as well.

Ioan Brancoveanu was a Tzimisce Voivode during the Dark Ages. He was a brilliant warlord, known as "the Hammer of the Tremere" or "the Butcher", for the remarkably grisly examples (yes, even for a Fiend) that he has made of captured Tremere. His lands lie in the mountains south-east of Karlsburg and south-west of Hermanstadt.

Invidia Caul is a Tremere geneticist who controls Kiowa Xenogenetics, a scientific research facility at a ranch on the Kiowa National Grassland in New Mexico, and also a Sire of the Courier if they're Tremere. She combines Blood Sorcery and advanced science, including cloning. Invidia is working on creating genetically engineered blood substitutes for Kindred to feed on, and believes that science can provide alternatives to regular Kindred feeding and may actually be one of the most game-changing Kindred as her cloned blood and hybridized blood is stuff that vampires can feed on.
Isabella is a Ghoul of the Tremere Lucubratio. She acts as castellan of the Paris Chantry in her master's absence.
The Auger is a rotary light machine gun added to Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare on May 2, 2017.

Jack Debiltongue was great Bone Gnawer of England who ruled over the Garou of London during late 1200s and early 1300s. He managed to save many wolves from death, slayed ruffians who abuse the poor, and defeated the Black Spiral Dancer Drededoom and his followers.

J. Oswald Hyde-White, also known as Ozzy, is a mysterious 7th generation Malkavian of Berlin who suffers from a derangement known as dissociative identity disorder. As such, there are at least three personalities coexisting inside his body: the collected Dr. Henry Jekyll, the savage Mr. Edward Hyde, and a third personality of the young reporter called Oswald White.
James Teesdale is a ghost who, in life, was rumored to be a witch who settled on the mounds so feared by the natives.
The Assassin Weapon Kit is a weapon kit available in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered.

Ivan Markovich is a draugr formerly of Clan Mekhet. Having immigrated to the United States with the aid of a clanmate with connections to the Russian shadow cult "People's Will", Markovich steadily became more and more envious of his friend throughout his years of paying back favors. Eventually, that envy broke off the last of Markovich's humanity. Now, he hunts down that friend and anyone bearing a connection to the shadow cult.
The Izizyii is a spirit/bygone hybrid creature and guardian to Horizon.

Ivo Shandor was a Malkavian elder of the Hartford Camarilla, and the sire of the architect Jonathan Smith. Disappointed by his childe, requested Jonathan to diablerize him in order to merge their minds and become an improved individual, and his childe obeyed. Despite the willing diablerie, the local Prince launched a blood hunt and Jonathan was forced to flee. With his sire's guiding voice in his head, Jonathan built the infamous Winchester Mystery House.

Staff Sergeant Augustine Perez is a playable character in Call of Duty: WWII. He is the commander of a M4 Sherman. He was wounded after his tank was knocked out by a German Tiger II in the level Hill 493, forcing him and his crew to bail out of the tank. In Operation Cobra, he displays little sympathy for Wehrmacht soldiers, referring to a burning body of one a "barbeque".
Jamison Keen is a Nosferatu ancilla with a criminal background, operating in the area of Seattle, Tacoma, and Bellevue, Washington with his coterie.
Jacob Risovich is a wraith and featured in the Last Danse Macabre adventure in Ends of Empire. He works for the Midnight Express as a Porter.
Jake Almerson is a Brujah of the New Orleans Camarilla, and a strong Iconoclast Brujah.
The Austen is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: WWII. It was added via an update on July 23rd, 2019.
Jaime Sangriento, sometimes known as the Voivode of Garbage, is a 13th-generation Tzimisce and the ductus of the Filth Angels pack in Mexico City.

Jane in a British Ananasi who works as a librarian in London. She starts dating Richard when she learns he is searching for a librarian to help him steal from the Tremere. An unnamed Garou attacks her for consorting with a bloodsucker, but she easily bests him in a fight. Richard eventually asks her to infiltrate Winters' haven in the Shard and steal a Tremere journal. There are wards against vampires, but they won't affect Fera, and as a librarian Jane will be able to tell the authentic journal from a fake. Jane kills two of Winters' security guards and breaks into his vault with the aid of Weaver-spirits; the wards burn her hand due to Richard's attempt to blood-bond her. Returning to Richard's flat, she kills him and leaves him with the fake journal, knowing it will trigger a war between his Clan and the Tremere. She explains that the blood bond doesn't work because she no longer feels love (and also she's been throwing out all the tainted wine he's been giving her).

Jaromír Černý is one of the younger Old Clan Tzimisce. Originally Embraced to stave off dangers for his sire during the , he is now a very unpopular inhabitant of Prague, with several enemies around and a sire that comes to see him as more and more dismissable. Despite not having access to the flesh-shaping arts of his Clan, he appears ungendered, alien, and not even altogether organic. Like an icon to a brutish and forgotten spirit — or demon — of the land, his features become coarse and otherworldly, a creature forged for a more primitive time, implying ties to the Gargoyles used by the Tremere.
The Auger DMR is a tactical rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4. It was developed in Santa Monica by the fictional manufacturer GUNNER. It also has a Mastercraft variant.
Jezebel Lee bani Flambeau is an apprentice of Gawain Alexander of the Order of Hermes. Unlike Alexander, she has some knowledge of the Spirit sphere.
:This article is about the Kithain named Jezebel. For other uses of this name, see Jezebel (disambiguation). Jezebel is a Seelie butterfly Pooka Wilder and part of the court at Tara-Nar.
Jeremiah is an Unseelie weasel Pooka Wilder who lives in Graymere Glen. He has a twin brother named Robin.

The Antelope A20 is a 4x4 Assault Vehicle featured on Battle Royale mode in Call of Duty: Mobile. It seats 3 players, one as the driver, one as a passenger and one as the gunner. The gun mounted on it is the Death Machine, does not need ammunition but instead overheats if overused and has to cool down.
Jezebel Locke is a minor character in . She was a vampire living in Downtown Los Angeles. Jezebel was a member of Brotherhood of the Ninth Circle, a dangerous vampire blood cult in Los Angeles.

Jim Taylor is a member of the Open Minds faction of the Null Mysteriis who commonly goes by the name “Contactee”. He claims to be hosting an Underworld spirit called the Taker of Children, who came to him when the hunter fell in a frozen lake and nearly died. He is currently under the hospitality of Mahasti Jalili, who is interrogating him for the spirit’s information on the supernatural.
Jeffrey Degenhardt II is the Warden of Ashcroft State Penitentiary. He opens a portal to the Shadowlands in order to bring back the ghosts of his family.

The Armor Box is a Field Upgrade featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, and a piece of equipment in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.
Javi "El Lupe" Chávarri is a Pure werewolf from Northeast Philadelphia.
Jeanette d'Avignon is a Malkavian of Medieval Jerusalem, and a seer with a split personality.
Jari is a Brujah gang leader of the London Anarchs, and the sire of Amy West.

The Armored Truck is a vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Warzone, that was first introduced with the Armored Royale game mode before being added during the Ground Fall and Rebirth Reinforced events. A variant of the Armored Truck, known as the Payload Truck, was available via the Payload game mode.
Jonas Albrecht, of the House Wyrmfoe, is a homid Ahroun werewolf, the King of the Silver Fangs tribe and bearer of the Silver Crown. His pack includes Mari Cabrah and Evan Heals-The-Past.

Johnny Y2K is a Ratkin metis who grew up in an IBM facility in Texas. Shunned by other rats and Ratkin, Johnny socialized with the spirits of computers and data instead, and became a talented self-taught programmer. He is also a masterful self-promoter, and claims credit for a variety of disastrous computer viruses. He has recently settled down and become a mentor to younger Ratkin with an interest in hacking.

Julius Abrogard was a 9th generation Malkavian, the sire of Dawn Nakada, Carter Vanderweyden and Marshall Bilton. He was versed in the art of acting, manipulation and etiquette. Abrogard was killed by a rival Tremere in 1955, at San Francisco.

The Armor Plates (also known as Armor Shards) are a utility featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4, Call of Duty: Warzone, Call of Duty: Mobile, Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0, Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile, Call of Duty: Black Ops 7, in the campaign of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6, as well as in the Zombies mode of Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, Call of Duty: Vanguard, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III, Call of Duty: Black Ops 6, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 7. The Armor Plates are also featured as a Scorestreak in Black Ops Cold War and a Field Upgrade in Vanguard.

John Paleologus was a powerful Byzantine Tzimisce who continued to rule despite the Ottoman conquest until Mustafa retook Istanbul with the help of the Ventrue and a Toreador named Vashtai. Considering the history of the city, he is most likely a descendant of the Dracon.
Johnny Mallory was a Spectre who lived in the 19th century United States.
José Chavez is a tenth generation Lasombra and the Bishop of El Paso, in the 1970s.
The Atomic Camouflage is a Weapon Camouflage in Call of Duty: WWII and Call of Duty: Vanguard.

Junius is a seventh generation Ventrue of the Eternal Senate, and the childe of Gnaeus. He received Ventrue attention when Rome invaded Cordoba, and he was one of the Roman legionnaires whose skill on the battlefield distinguished itself.
John Davis is a wraith and member of the Oracle Guild featured in the Last Danse Macabre adventure in Ends of Empire.

Kataragama is the legendary Bodhisattva that founded the Dharma of the Flame of the Rising Phoenix. He returned from Yomi when the Yama King Ravana held sway over Sri Lanka and India from his fortress on Ceylon and his raksha servants terrorized mortals and Kuei-jin alike. Kataragama, after being instructed in the ways of his brethren, chose not to adhere to the Fivefolded Way laid down by Xue, but instead returned to his family and continued to care and protect them. He rallied the local Beast Courts and several other shen, alongside other Kuei-jin who followed his example, and eventually banished Ravana and his fortress back into Yomi, restoring the natural balance on the island again. It is said that Kataragama eventually achieved transcendence through the simple act of living. Today, the village where he lived with his family is named in his honor.
The is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard. It was added on March 22nd, 2022 as part of the Season Two Reloaded update.

The Kaliya is Gaia's deathsman, one of the terrible dragon spirits of the Wani. He is called by the Nagah to punish those whose deeds have dealt the whole of Gaia a blow, like the accountables for the massacres against the Fera. It has to be noted, however, that the Kaliya only attacks individuals, whose guilt cannot be denied. Death by the fangs of the Kaliya is a slow and painful manner, the victims often take decades to die. There are two known victims of the Kaliya: Vinata, the renegade Nagah who triggered the War of Rage, and the Black Spiral Dancer Mara the Scream, who triggered the War of Tears.
Kestry is a Seelie Sidhe Wilder of House Liam in the Kingdom of Ulster in Hibernia.
Kalila, also known as the Firebug, is a pyromaniac Malkavian anarch of the 11th generation.
The Armored Transport Truck is a ground vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Warzone. It was added as part of the Season Two update of Call of Duty: Vanguard. It is only available in Caldera.
Kameria Shula Fairmont is a member of Verbena and a shapeshifter.

The spirit-speaker of her pack, Kalila Bleeding-Edge thrives in the urban landscape of Denver, Colorado. Socially savvy, witty, and sharp-tongued, she loves her concrete-paved hunting ground and has little patience for those who fail to see the beauty and danger in the city. Kalila revels in the double-edged "blessing" of being a werewolf, and is happy to have left behind the person she was before the First Change — reminders of her past can set her into terrible rages. Her pleasure in her condition often makes her too flashy for her own good, though, and she consistently attracts unwelcome attention from hostile spirits from her overt displays of spiritual power.

The Karpani were Persian witch-poets active prior to and during the . Following Alexander's conquest, they were forced to take the position formerly occupied by the Zoroastrian priests (the magi from whom willworkers would eventually take their common name of "mage"). They made up one of the four great cults of the time period.

Armor Rig Reyes is a Unit that appears in Call of Duty: Siege. Reyes is the character, Nick Reyes from Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. He can be unlocked from the Supply Drops as well as from the Quartermaster for Platinum and appears as an and card.
Kemod was the spirit of a Chemikon-owned coal-fired power plant in the Pioneer Valley and one of the greatest lieutenants of Eater-of-Names.

Keegan is a seventh generation Gangrel and the sire of Anthius. She Embraced Anthius in a farm near Seattle, telling him tales of wilderness and wandering around the forests. Anthius accompanied her to the opposite coast of the United States, before departing the companionship of his sire.
Kamilah is a ninth generation Nosferatu of Chicago and the sire of Rowan. She met and Embraced an acid trip-induced Rowan during a burner festival, and abandoned them right after.
The Armored SUV is a ground vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Warzone. It was added as part of the Season Four update of Call of Duty: Vanguard. It is a modified version of the SUV.

Justinian I was the Emperor of the and ruler of Constantinople at its greatest height. He succeeded to power and greatly expanded the empire, with the help of the powerful Ventrue Antonius of the Trinity.
Kalyani is a powerful Assamite antitribu and a Sabbat Bishop.
Kao Chien-Li is a wraith in the Yellow Springs. He is featured in the adventure in "A Guided Tour of Hell" in Dark Kingdom of Jade.
Anti-Armor Rounds are featured as a Field Upgrade in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.
Justitia is a tenth generation Gargoyles from medieval France, in service to Aymeric de Saintonge, the Salubri Prince of Bourges.

Kallias is a mysterious Kindred who appeared in Birmingham, UK. The domain was shaken in 2021, with the arrival of the charismatic Kallias, who claimed to have achieved Golconda. His performing of various "marvels" throughout the city saw a cult of personality rapidly coalesce around this newcomer, with even Prince Jeremiah Casaubon becoming enraptured by the mystical promise of Kallias' teachings.
Kamakshi is the spring auspice of the Nagah. These Nagah are inclined toward actions of renewal and healing.
The Anti-Vehicle Mag is a type of ammunition featured in Call of Duty: Mobile exclusive to the ZRG 20mm.

Justin Stone is a 10th Generation Gangrel and the principal Camarilla enforcer operating around Ann Arbor, Michigan. He styles himself the “Archon of Ann Arbor.” But the title isn't officially recognised by the Camarilla, but neither has the sect censured him for using it.
The Khan, also known as the Bright Kings, are weretigers, and are one of the nine remaining tribes of the Bastet.

Khalil Ravana is the signature character and one of the few survivors of the Ravnos clan in Vampire: The Masquerade. He is noted for his dangerous addiction to diablerie, which he has used to bring himself down to the ninth generation.
The Armor Satchel is an equipment featured in Call of Duty: Warzone, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0 and Call of Duty: Mobile.
Ko'leel is a Dragon Chimera and guardian of Kaliandrana's Grotto on the island of Kauai in Hawaii.
Kieran Cotterill is a twelfth-generation Nosferatu Neonate. He works as a historian for the Camarilla.
Konstantin was an old Lasombra Autarkis. Around 2000, he was diablerized by his clan mate Andrew Emory in the pursuit of Konstantin's infamous friend, Lucita de Aragon.
Archon's Hammer is a multiplayer campaign mission featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and it was available during Season 10: World Class, as a modification of the Payload Battle Royale mode.
King Ironheart is a Knocker King of Middlemarch from the Arcadia CCG.
Kuei, or Hungry Ghosts, nearly mindless manifestations of the disgruntled p'o who has not been properly buried. They wander the Yellow Springs causing mayhem.
Lars Svengaard was a Tzimisce who first manifested the Kraken's Kiss ability of the Vicissitude Discipline.

Assassin Build Sniper is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is exclusive to the "Spectre" Prototype Weapon version of the UDM. It is a fusion of the Assassin Build and Sniper Mod gun perks, converting the weapon into a semi-automatic sniper-esque weapon that also has an integrated silencer that upon killing enemies, prevents the location of their death from popping up on the Minimap.

Larth Fulumchva, now known erroneously as Nesna Nethshrac, was an Etruscan priest and necromancer who succeeded in becoming a liche in the fourth century BCE. Just before the Roman army conquered his home city of Tarquinia (Tarchna), Larth was captured by the Cult of Mercury and magically bound in an underground tomb. For nearly two and a half thousand years, he stewed over the conquest of his city and his burning desire for revenge.
Laura Pritchard is a kidnapping/murder victim-turned-vengeful ghost currently haunting her killer, David D'Angelo.
